skip.why: A long hunt for the rare species
A hard manoeuvre, twice, on a timer

parts.title: Chapter 1: Just Like Paradise
parts.lede: The Leonida Keys, almost all as Jason. The chapter ends with the house and your carried cash gone, so everything in Part B has to be done before mission 20.

items.t: **Install update 01.002.002 (Nov 23) before you play on.** It fixes phone calls that didn't come through, including the ones that unlock missions, partners not handing over bags for fences, and autosave. [Patch notes](/guides/patch-notes/).
**Ashes of Glory:** on the table next to Jason's bed. The house is gone after Chapter 1.
**Lethal By Design:** on the living room table in Jason's house.
**Orca: A Whole Different Animal:** on the living room table by the east window.
**Off the Hook:** in the tool shed under Jason's house.
**Body Copy:** on the back deck of the house, by the weights.
**RX Men:** on the magazine rack in the 247 store in Key Lento.
**Pool at The Rusty Anchor,** Key Lento: the bar from the story has a regular opponent too. If nobody's there, come back later. [All seven opponents](/guides/races-and-ranges/#pool).

items.n: Scanning with WAiNK counts. Keep scanning after this: the checklist wants 200.
Keep going after this: the checklist wants 100 animals.

items.t: **Get Shirley's Rum.** Optional, and only exists in Chapter 1.
**Steal the Scooter.** Optional, and only exists in Chapter 1.

**Start Kenton's dives.** After Island Dreams he calls, then shows up under a green KR icon in Key Lento. All seven of his treasure sets are in Mariana County, so this is the time to dive: [the sets and their pieces](/guides/side-contacts/#kenton-treasure). He drops off the map after Chapter 1 and returns later.

items.n: Fits a day of diving.

items.t: **Start the three games on the home TV:** Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind. Starting each one counts, and the console is out of reach in Chapter 2.

**Cal's fishing challenge.** Cal texts Jason after Feng Shui: take a boat to his spot in Gambit Bay and land a stoplight parrotfish over 2 lbs for Baited My Tackle and a Focus boost. [Cal's challenge](/guides/side-contacts/#cal).
**Optional errands before Coming Home:** Pick up Groceries, Buy Flowers, Buy Lucia a Necklace, Get The Chop, Get Lucia's Clothes.
**Gunslinger:** take down 5 enemies in one use of combat focus.

**Find the Lost Drugs.** Optional, Jason. A call after Down to Earth: four search zones in the Mariana County swamps, then drop the packages at Donnie's trailer. [Step by step](/guides/optional-jobs/#lost-drugs).
**The balcony meditation.** The morning after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen and follow her to the balcony. It may count toward Positive Mental Attitude, and it does not come back.

**Clock Out.** Optional, Jason. Lucia calls after Day Release, during the day: accept, and get to the Key Lento Community Center in a car before 4 PM, or it fails. The call doesn't come in every game. [Step by step](/guides/optional-jobs/#clock-out).

**Donnie's Lost Drugs.** Optional, Jason, after Swamped. Take a boat out to the pink search area off Corsair Key, dive to Donnie's sunken boat and bring the bag to Brian's lockup for $1,200. [Step by step](/guides/optional-jobs/#donnie-drugs).
**Take Donnie's H&L .38** from the trunk before you get rid of his car. It is a unique revolver, one of the two [unique weapons](/guides/unique-weapons/) you can miss.

items.n: A use for cash you would otherwise lose in mission 20.

Everything we have mapped in the Keys, area by area. The Jason's house items go when Chapter 1 ends; the rest can wait, but Key Lento is home for now, so its hoops, cards and WAiNK scans are on your doorstep.

groups.h: Part C: point of no return

items.t: **Manual save in a slot of its own**, before you talk to Lucia on the beach. Keep it.
**Deposit your cash**, ideally at least $5,000 in Family Savings. Anything you carry is lost.

parts.title: Chapter 2: Paradise Lost
parts.lede: Port Gellhorn, with the Starlet Motel as home. You play Lucia until Coffee Break. After it you can switch freely, and most of the side jobs open.

items.t: **Manual save** at the start of the chapter.
**Help Me Help You Help Me:** on the table in the Starlet Motel reception. The motel is gone after Chapter 2.
**The Wizard Wang book:** on a table in the Starlet Motel cafeteria.
**Vicki card:** in the bathroom of the motel office, on the floor by the toilet.
**Victor Maravilla card:** on the fridge in the motel kitchen.
**The Johnsons (Issue 1):** inside Alpha Gas, northeast of the motel.
**Check Out McKittrick Farm.** Read Kyle's flyer on the wall outside the motel reception to start it. [Kyle's jobs](/guides/side-contacts/#kyle).

**Gellhorn's Missing Tourists.** Look at a missing tourists poster (Starlet Motel reception, or outside the 24/7 south of Delights), check the three lockers in the building north of Moses's shop, then find and report the three bodies around Port Gellhorn. Jason or Lucia. [The case](/guides/side-contacts/#alvan).
**Pick Up A Gun.** Optional, Lucia. Buy a gun at Gellhorn Outfitters in Port Gellhorn, or take one out of the gun locker. [Optional jobs](/guides/optional-jobs/#pick-up-gun).

items.n: Gets you the [Slim Jim](/guides/equipment/#slim-jim) for quiet car theft.

items.t: **On the Spot:** register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. At Moses, respray and then register. You need a free garage space for each, and early on only cars without a tracker are accepted. [How registering works](/guides/cars/#personal).

**Steal Vehicles for Moses.** Six cars, one at a time, from Port Gellhorn out to Kelly County, Grayson and Ambrosia; deliver all six and he leaves you his Sultan in Collect Moses' Gift. The last one, a Nightblade, is at a Final Chapter hideout, so you can leave it for later. [Moses's jobs](/guides/side-contacts/#moses).

**Little Boxes:** the garages are sold through the Vice City Real Estate app from here. There are 8 to buy, $160,000 in all; the cheapest is Mitchell Auto Center ($4,000), just east of Port Gellhorn. [Every garage](/guides/garages/).
**Dicked Down Deep in Space:** in a trailer at Lost Vista, the robbery spot Dunk marks, northwest of the Port Gellhorn Station garage.
**Collect Chemicals for Kyle.** He texts about a day after the first job.

items.n: Should arrive on its own around here if you scan and study as you go.

items.t: **Missing Person.** Once all three bodies are reported, go back to the locker room. It switches between Jason and Lucia, so it only works from here on. Ends the strand, which counts toward Strangers & Freaks. [The case](/guides/side-contacts/#alvan).
**Hit Avery Pawn.** Pawn shops count as Smash 'N' Grabs from here; it's one of the three in Kelly County. [All 35](/guides/robberies/#smash).

**Hit Kingpin Bowling.** Bring sticky bombs and take all three valuables: the watch in the southeast office, the shotgun on a table in the northeast corner, and the safe in the northeast hallway office. A hidden trophy depends on it.
**Impounded Vehicle.** Drive through the police lot fence by the Port Gellhorn station, take Lucia's car and lose two stars. [Step by step](/guides/optional-jobs/#impound).
**Veteran Hunted.** Jason only, in Lummox County; go alone. Opens Bret's hunts and his Target Decks. [Bret](/guides/side-contacts/#bret).

**Wyman's Classic Car Collection** (Ultimate Edition only). Once you have the Dominator buggy, Wyman texts about his first car. Scan the Transgressor's three pieces around Port Gellhorn now, and the Mamba GT's Kelly County ones when he asks; each car costs $1,500. [All 15 scrap spots](/guides/classic-cars/).

items.n: You keep the Sanchez from Billy's job.

groups.h: With your partner, in one session

items.t: **Hot Together:** lose a 4 star wanted level together. Call your partner from the phone first. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia is an easy place to shake the police.

items.n: The same chase as Hot Together.

groups.h: While you are based in Kelly County

items.t: **Pool at Delights Cabaret,** Port Gellhorn. Beat the opponent before the chapter ends, or wait until the club reopens later.

**The alien secret.** Go alone after 2 AM to the dirt roads north-west of the Starlet Motel and look for an abandoned car with flashing lights. The dream and the rescue south of Hamlet can wait, but the reward (more maximum health, stamina and focus for both leads) helps with everything after. [Step by step](/guides/mysteries/#aliens).
**Swamp meditation:** the wooden dock by the lookout tower in Buckskin Swamp. Do it with both Jason and Lucia.
**Worn Stone meditation:** the bank of the Emerald River at Camp Moonflower. Both characters.
**Red Rocks meditation:** near the train tracks crossing the highway in Manifest Canyon. Both characters.

items.n: A gym can be joined with your partner from Coffee Break on.
While one of you works out, the other trains too.
The Starlet Motel items go when Chapter 2 ends. The swamp, canyon and Emerald Springs spots stay, but you are next door now.
Bret's hunts bring Jason up here from Veteran Hunted. Grab what is on the way; the rest fits the free roam sweep.

items.t: **Manual save in a slot of its own.** It is your way back to Chapter 2 free roam.
**Have at least $15,000 in BuckMe.** The mission won't start without it.
**Finish what you want to do from the Starlet Motel.** It stops being your home.

parts.title: Chapter 3: Tits Ass Drug Money
parts.lede: Vice City opens, and with it Pay 'n' Spray, jewelry stores, bank jobs and most of the fences.

items.t: **Manual save** at the start of the chapter.
**Passion B.C.:** next to the bathtub in the Bayside apartment. The apartment is gone after Chapter 3.
**Two Pricks in the Bush:** on the table in front of the TV in the Bayside apartment.
**The home console works again.** Start the games now if you missed them.
**Kenton is back.** Carry on diving.

items.n: The checklist wants all 33.

items.t: **Get Your Wheels.** Both cars were impounded after Chapter 2. Get one back with the Scooter Bros app, or register another car at a Pay 'n' Spray. [Optional jobs](/guides/optional-jobs/#get-wheels).
**Join a Street Race.** Jason only, in Salton. [Yago's jobs](/guides/side-contacts/#yago).
**Bumper to Bumper.** Yago's shop in Little Cuba.
**Race Against Yago.** Limited time: do it the moment the hourglass shows up.
**Brother to Brother.** The strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

**Papa Audacity's strand.** Jason or Lucia, from the park at the south end of Ocean Beach: The Unknown Stuntman, Trial by Tire (same character; beat x50 on the roof), Quit Your Job, Sell Your House (keep the AudaCity Sandking), then the seven AudaCity Stunts. [His jobs](/guides/side-contacts/#audacity).
**Catching a Whale, then The Audacity.** Sell your DacityCoin in the app before the bike jump at the launch party (about $25,000). The strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

items.n: Gets you the [Pry Bar and Cut-Off Tool](/guides/equipment/#ch3): wooden crates and the yellow SCOOP containers.

items.t: **Reynolds Kit Car for Wyman** (Ultimate Edition). With the Cut-Off Tool you can open the SCOOP container at Wild Hog Point, the one piece of the Kit Car that was locked away. The Deviant follows without a hunt. [Kit Car spots](/guides/classic-cars/#kit-car).
**Say yes to Halifax.** Turning him down can cost you the later parts of the job and their rewards once the chapter ends. [Story choices](/guides/story-choices/).

**Andy's strand.** Lucia only. During the chapter Andy calls her, then texts an address in Belville. Five jobs: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee ($5,000, paid back at the end), Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass. [Andy's jobs](/guides/side-contacts/#andy).
**While you are in Belville:** the magazine Foiled is on a bed in a break-in garage on the northern row of houses, west of Andy's house, and The Thirsty Wolf has a pool opponent.
**Take Out Kitty Litter.** Jason only. Destroy the labs at the purple markers in Vice City until Tyrone gives you his last job. [Lab tracker](/guides/side-contacts/#kitty-litter-labs).
**Pool at Zotico's,** Balsero, while you are at Randy's dealership.
**Xero Food Mart, La Perle:** Ratface (Issue 1) and Special Friends Force (Issue 1) on the magazine rack.
**Three posters in La Perle** for the first playlist. Scan them with WAiNK: by the cashier in Aunt Zola's Soul Food, on the table by the door in TWA Ponya Tattoo, and on the counter in Drip Drops.
**Jack of Hearts club, Crosstown:** the fourth poster is on a crate in the eastern recording booth upstairs, and High Rollerz (Issue 37) is in the hallway west of the booths.
**The Vault nightclub, Downtown:** the red poster inside the entrance completes the second playlist.
**¡BOMBAZO! (Issue 2342):** on the magazine rack in Ron Stop'n'Snack, Washington Beach.

items.n: Any [convenience store](/guides/shops/#convenience-stores) counts: there are 72, so one is always close.

items.t: **Yasmani, first store: Casa de Empeno.** Hand the piece in straight away to get the [Snap Gun](/guides/equipment/#snap-gun). [Yasmani's jobs](/guides/side-contacts/#yasmani).
**Yasmani, the other two stores**, through the back door with the Snap Gun.

**Sneakthief:** rob a jewelry store without being detected. Use the Snap Gun on a back door, find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe. Richardson Jewelry is a good one for it.

**Retail Therapy:** rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City are close enough together. If it doesn't unlock after the third, rob a fourth.

items.n: Gets you the [Dye Pack Jammer](/guides/equipment/#dye-pack-jammer).

items.t: **Bank jobs and payday loans are open**, and marked bills can be fenced. [Every bank and payday loan](/guides/robberies/#banks). [Fences](/guides/fences/).
**Rob the Little Cuba payday loan again as Lucia**, on her own, and leave on foot, not in a car. A hidden trophy depends on it.
**A Classic Blitz Play:** rob an armored truck and escape. Block one, put a sticky bomb on the back door and lose the heat. Yasmani's shop sells sticky bombs once his jobs are done.
**Buddy?** Kyle's last text comes around the middle of the chapter. His strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

items.n: Gets you the [Key Cloner](/guides/equipment/#key-cloner).

items.t: **Randy's wish list.** High-end sports cars: scan a car with WAiNK to see if it is on the list, then deliver it to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are good hunting grounds, and Randy points you to the next car after each delivery. The Vitello (Waning Sands) and Infernus (Crosstown police car park) have fixed spots. [Wish-list checklist](/guides/side-contacts/#randy-list).
**Mall Rats.** Billy's next job arrives during this chapter.

items.n: The key cloner opens locked high-end cars.
Take the red bag near the end of the table in the first room. Leave the room without it and its cash and bonus are gone.
[All 18 hair and beauty salons by county](/guides/shops/#salons).
[All 67 clothing stores by county](/guides/shops/#clothing-stores).

items.t: **Little Boxes:** start buying the garage properties. [Prices and areas](/guides/garages/#compare).
**Treat Yo Self:** all of this spending counts toward the $100,000.

items.n: The Bayside apartment items go when Chapter 3 ends. Everything else stays.
Ocean Beach and Washington Beach.
Hamlet, the airport, Southside and Vespucci Island.
Belville comes up with Andy's jobs; Waning Sands is on the coast to the north.

items.t: **Manual save in a slot of its own.**

parts.title: Chapter 4: Vice City, Baby
parts.lede: Three things to plan around: a limited-time optional mission for Lucia, a $75,000 fee after Party Hard, and Making Gainz, after which Jason and Lucia can't be together in public until VCIA Takedown is done. The bank vaults open at the very end of the chapter.

items.t: **Manual save** at the start of the chapter.
**This Is a Free Call From…** Optional, Lucia only and limited-time. Take it straight away.
**Attend Eddie Acosta's Party.** He texts a few days after you meet him. Go alone. [Eddie](/guides/side-contacts/#eddie).
**Remote Strike:** in the trauma room area of Ajax Gym, Vice Beach. Lucia can get in from Chapter 4.

**Pilot Pete.** Jason only. He calls early in the chapter. Passing the Torch, Backseat Pilot, then three timed Pete's Deliveries; they count toward Strangers & Freaks. [Pete's jobs](/guides/side-contacts/#pete).

items.n: Afterwards the **Thompson Court Garage** in Ocean Beach is yours: two more spaces for [On the Spot](/trophies/on-the-spot/).

items.t: **Have $75,000 ready for Pay Abe's Fee.** After Party Hard, Abe's law firm texts you for the fee. Pay it in the BuckMe app; the story doesn't move on until you do.

**Bad Driver!** Optional. Andrea calls about Felipe after Party Hard; he's at a bar in Millport, Lummox County. Killing him pays $20,000; sparing him leads to Collect Felipe's Gift later. Gone for good once Power Play starts. [Step by step](/guides/optional-jobs/#bad-driver).
**It's A Date!** Optional. Take Jason and Lucia together to the Courtyard Bar in Stockyard, buy a drink and walk back out. [Optional jobs](/guides/optional-jobs/#its-a-date).

**Dre'Quan's Gift.** A few in-game days after Photo/Shoot, pick up the KD's SFB 1000 race bike behind the Pay 'n' Spray in La Perle. Keep it if you have no fast bike yet. [Optional jobs](/guides/optional-jobs/#drequan-gift).

**Finish what needs Jason and Lucia together before the next mission:** Hot Together, Retail Therapy, gym sessions as a pair and the meditations. After Making Gainz they can't be seen together in public until VCIA Takedown is done.

items.n: Goes on the map with Abe's call (*Rafa's Kidnapping* in the mission list) once Jason has nothing else open.
Goes on the map with Nate's call (*Nate Will Be in Touch*): finish Jason's open missions, then play as Lucia.

items.t: **Manual save in a slot of its own**, with the preparation missions done.

items.n: A unique LMG lies on the ground during the last fight as Jason. Pick it up before you get in the van.

items.t: **That's Where The Money Is…** Optional, at the very end of the chapter. Opens the eight large bank vaults: tail a security van to the bank, go in while the vault is open and hand one bag to your partner. [Money guide](/guides/money/), [the eight banks](/guides/robberies/#vaults).
**Maximum Withdrawal:** rob 5 vaults. The checklist wants all 8.
**Manual save** at the end of the chapter.

parts.title: Chapter 5: Top of the World, Ma
parts.lede: Seven missions in a row. Their names give the ending away, so they are numbers only here; the names are behind the spoiler block on the walkthrough page.

items.t: **At the end of mission 91** you get back the weapons, equipment and outfits you had before this chapter, plus **$50,000** towards Abe's fee, and two more garages (NE 15th Street and Pegassi Residences, five spaces between them). Leaving the penthouse afterwards starts a short cutscene at Abe's office.

**Have $150,000 ready for Abe's second fee.** After mission 91, Abe's office wants it through BuckMe, and mission 92 doesn't open until it's paid. [Mission 92](/walkthrough/protective-custody/#before-you-start).

**Move your money into Family Savings** before you confirm mission 92. Money outside it is lost once the ending starts; Family Savings is kept for after the story. The savings target Abe's office texts you about isn't needed. [Money guide](/guides/money/#keep-it).
**Manual save in a slot of its own** before mission 92. The last two missions run back to back, and there is no replay.
**After the credits** the game puts you back in free roam at the point just before mission 92, so nothing left on the map is lost. [What to do after the story](/guides/after-the-story/).
**Lights, Camera, Affirmative Action:** on a table in the penthouse you reach during this chapter.
**Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion** and see what is left.

parts.title: Free roam
parts.lede: Six blocks, in this order; block D is four separate days. The number at the end of a line is what the 100% checklist asks for.

items.t: **Bank jobs:** cash drawer and safe at all 14 small banks, plus the 8 large ones. [Tick list](/guides/robberies/#banks).
**Vaults.** [The eight banks](/guides/robberies/#vaults).
**Payday loans:** counter and back-room safe. [Tick list](/guides/robberies/#payday).
**Smash 'N' Grabs:** display cases and the back-room safe; one of the 35 can be skipped. [Tick list](/guides/robberies/#smash).
**Stick ups.**
**Fence totals:** narcotics $100,000, jewelry $100,000, marked bills $250,000, vehicles $200,000.

items.n: Half of the vehicle total in one go.

groups.h: B: one region at a time

items.t: **Finish each county's collectible list.** They sit in the chapters above, and every county has [its own checklist page](/collectibles/#by-area). We add spots as they are confirmed.
**Gang operations.** One from each of the nine gangs earns Pest Control. [All 39 by gang](/guides/gang-operations/).

items.n: A job for Donnie's .38.

items.t: **Cocaine Flamingos.**

**Stunts.** Cunning Stunts unlocks at 250. Any mix of the four kinds counts, but stunt jumps, knife flights and base jumps only add up to 195, so plan on at least 105 under the bridge stunts (55 for the trophy). The 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps are the shortest lists. [Stunt checklists](/guides/stunts/), with all 130 stunt jumps by region.
**Basketball hoops.** Courts give two at a time; the big clusters are on the [hoops page](/collectibles/basketball-hoops/).
**Drone time trials.** Beat par on the first two at each spot to open the third. A win at all 14 locations earns Top Fun. [All 42 with par times](/guides/races-and-ranges/#drones).
**WAiNK locations.** Also earns You WAiNKer! Most landmarks, curiosities and sculptures are [mapped by county](/collectibles/waink-locations/).
**Meditation spots.** Every spot counts once for Jason and once for Lucia. Positive Mental Attitude needs all 18.
**Smooth Sand:** a small sandbar off the west coast of Capri, Mariana County.
**Water Wheel:** by the waterwheel of a ruined paper mill, south of Moreau.
**Jutting Cliff:** a tower overlooking a mine in Mount Kalaga National Park.
**Waterfall:** northwest of Tallaloko, overlooking a waterfall.
**Seaside:** a rocky outcrop on the beach east of Waning Sands.
**Ascent:** the stone circle at the peak of Mount Kalaga. It only appears once every other meditation is done, and it needs both characters together.

**Collectible Card sets.** Don't Touch My Deck unlocks at 3. The [Vice City Flamingos](/collectibles/collectible-cards/vice-city-flamingos/) are fully mapped (24 cards, the Bubblegum cheat); their spots are already in the county lists above.
**Underwater discoveries.**
**Kenton sets**, and his last mission for a hidden trophy. [Set tracker](/guides/side-contacts/#kenton-treasure).
**Magazines, books and comics.** 27 readables plus 7 book swaps. Not every location is documented yet, so pick up the ones listed in the chapters above.
**The Cowboy's Prayer is to Die Young:** on a table in the unmarked building north of Taco Bomb, West Kalaga.
**Styles**, and the two playlists.
**The Goodtime State:** uncover the whole map.
**Shooting range golds.** Buy the $5 Waiver Pass at Griffin and Rodgers Ranch first. Also earns The Shootist. [Every medal and its gun](/guides/races-and-ranges/#ranges).
**Unique races won.** Earn Cash, Not Kudos unlocks at 20. [The six venues](/guides/races-and-ranges/#races).
**Race challenge golds.** [All 13](/guides/races-and-ranges/#race-challenges).

items.n: King Gator is in Buckskin Swamp, Frontier in Waning Sands. The third, Dino Golf Challenge, is in Frogswater. Any two cover the checklist.

items.t: **Pool opponents.** The Rusty Anchor (Key Lento), Skeeter's (Hamlet), Zotico's (Balsero), The Thirsty Wolf (Belville), Jacob's Tavern (Milport), Delights Cabaret (Port Gellhorn) and Kowaachobee Cafe & Bar (Buckskin Swamp). [Tick list](/guides/races-and-ranges/#pool).

items.n: Counts toward the 15 miles too.
Frontier Adventure Golf and the Seaside meditation are in Waning Sands too.
Every county has a station: [all 25 train stations by county](/guides/shops/#train-stations).
Refuel stops only: [all 57 gas stations by county](/guides/shops/#gas-stations).
Buy every lure type first. [Fishing, hunting and the animal log](/guides/fishing-and-hunting/#lures).

items.t: **Baited My Tackle:** beat Cal in his fishing challenge (a stoplight parrotfish over 2 lbs in Gambit Bay), if you skipped it in Chapter 1. [Cal's challenge](/guides/side-contacts/#cal).

items.n: [Hunting with Bret](/guides/fishing-and-hunting/#hunting).

items.t: **Bret's Target Decks**, as Jason.

items.n: [Every gun store, mod shop, clothing and shoe store, salon, tattoo studio and gas station by county](/guides/shops/).

items.t: **Standard issue weapons.**
**Little Boxes, On the Spot and Treat Yo Self:** finish all three. [Garages and their spaces](/guides/garages/).

**1010 Murals (not needed for 100%):** photograph the five murals in Vice City and Ocean Beach to open the Southside Storage garage and win the 1010 Cheetah. [1010 Murals](/collectibles/1010-murals/).
**Billy:** The Impaler, then Hometown Heroes (Jason and Lucia together), which ends the strand. [Billy's jobs](/guides/side-contacts/#billy).
**Randy, Tyrone, Kenton and Bret:** finish each strand. [Side contacts](/guides/side-contacts/).

**Strangers & Freaks:** 8 strands, and all eight that count are known: Kirk, Kyle, the missing tourists, Yago, Papa Audacity, Pilot Pete, Dr. Merle and Freddie. Cal, Shirley, Moses, Billy, Andy, Yasmani, Tyrone, Eddie and Shayna don't. [Strand tracker](/guides/side-contacts/#strangers-and-freaks).

**The Final Flush (Dr. Merle):** scan a No Flushers poster in a public bathroom, reply TRUTH, meet him at Frank's Waffles. Open in any chapter and it raises max stamina for good, so do it early if you like. Counts toward Strangers & Freaks. [Dr. Merle](/guides/side-contacts/#merle).

**Retest Freddie's Defenses (Freddie):** two visits to his compound on Lake Leonida (tunnel first, water tower second). $10,000, switches on hurricane weather, counts toward Strangers & Freaks. [Freddie](/guides/side-contacts/#freddie).
**Kirk:** Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove (Lucia only, from Chapter 2). All at night. [Kirk's strand](/guides/side-contacts/#kirk).
**Master of None:** fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, a basketball hoop, a video game, a race win and a stunt.
**Stick Fiddler:** beat every level of one game, on the home TV or a Bang For Your Buck cabinet.
**Challenging Tank:** the tanks are in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, on the southwest island of Mariana County. Get in one and use it on enemies.
**Base model vehicles scanned**, and 100 animals studied.
**Challenges.** One Last Thing unlocks at 50.
**A Long Road:** 100% completion.
